title: MCP capture document
description: Ordered record of read-only MCP tool calls captured by a host agent (Mode A) and replayed deterministically by the library. Raw captures may contain real customer data and must stay in the git-ignored .captures/ directory. Size limits (max entries, per-entry and per-file bytes) are enforced by the loader in adapters/mcp/capture.js, not only by this schema.

source_system.description: Source system label, for example salesforce or m365.

connector.description: Connector label, for example the MCP server name.

entries.description: Calls in the order they were made. Each entry has exactly one of result or error.

args.description: Arguments exactly as sent to the tool.

result.description: Raw MCP tool result (content/structuredContent/isError) or raw connector payload; any JSON value.

error.description: Transport or connector error, for example {error_code, status_code, body} or {code, message}.
